item.title: Forgiveness Is God’s Command, Not a Suggestion
item.description: Doreen Virtue explains Jesus’ command to forgive in Matthew 6:14–15, showing how God empowers us to forgive and walk in freedom.

item.title: Standing Firm Against Deception: Lessons from Nehemiah 6
item.description: In Nehemiah 6, Nehemiah faces deception, intimidation, and false accusations. This episode explores how Christians can stand firm by relying on God’s strength and discerning truth from lies.

item.title: The New Arianism in the Church: Why Denying the Deity of Christ Is a Gospel Issue
item.description: Many evangelicals now deny the full deity of Jesus Christ. This Weekly Watch episode examines the rise of New Arianism and why Christ’s deity is essential to the gospel.

item.title: Remembered by Name: Faithful Record Keepers in Nehemiah 7
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Nehemiah 7 and shows how God remembers His people by name. This chapter reveals that every act of faithfulness matters and that God preserves His covenant people across generations.
